overview: A heavy Elon day: he is pushing Grok 4.7 and Grok Bot hard, rebranding AI as 'SI', and calling SpaceX 'a super intelligence company'. On the money side, Coinbase added 26 tokenized stocks and set a $150k live trading contest for Oct 8, and Vistra reportedly got a $4B federal nuclear loan. Most of BillAckman's and some of Elon's feeds were politics and France riot reposts, which are skipped here.

top_items.title: Elon Musk - Endorses claims that Grok 4.7 'writes great code' and promotes Grok Bot, whose lead reportedly shipped 2,500 PRs in a month
Elon Musk - Posts 'SpaceX is a super intelligence company' after declaring 'No more AI, SI'; both posts drew millions of views
Elon Musk - Says Dept of War revenue is about 3% of SpaceX's December ARR and roughly 1% across all his companies
Brian Armstrong - Coinbase Wallet adds 26 new tokenized stocks; $150k IRL trading contest streams from Singapore on Oct 8
burrytracker - Reposts report that the Trump administration is giving Vistra a $4B loan to upgrade 3 nuclear plants
Elon Musk - Amplifies realtor Jason Oppenheim swapping his Bentley for a Model Y and buying Teslas with FSD for 10 employees
Elon Musk - Highlights Farmersville, California voting 4-1 to have Grok draft council meeting minutes from recordings
Chamath Palihapitiya - Makes 'the case for giving everyone GLPs', citing a Social Capital estimate of ~$400B/yr in GDP per year of slowed aging
